tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
5/6

Bitway unlocks 101.6 million BTW on 2 November, 6.7 % of the coins in circulation. Unlocks that size cost a median 8.5 %.

Since 14 October, BTW has already lost 24 % against Bitcoin. That is nearly three times the typical cost of such an unlock.

tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
4/6

What the unlock itself adds, median against Bitcoin:

→ month before   −4.3 %
→ month after    −0.7 %, not distinguishable from zero

The date is public months ahead, so anyone who wants out can sell early. By unlock day, the discount has been paid.

tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
3/6

The same coins in windows of equal length without any unlock, 61 days against Bitcoin:

→ with unlock     74 % down, median −17 %
→ without unlock  70 % down, median −13 %

Most of the loss is the normal altcoin discount against Bitcoin. The unlock comes on top.

tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
2/6

The market maker Keyrock wrote in December 2024 that 90 % of unlocks create negative price pressure.

Measured against Bitcoin, from 30 days before to 30 days after each unlock, 75 % of coins ended down, by a median 17 %. Three in four, not nine in ten.
